description:
Traditional pastries like radish cake, rice cake, pineapple cake, and mochi are not acutely poisonous, but they are highly inappropriate for cats. These festive treats are packed with high amounts of starch, sugar, and glutinous rice. Because cats are strictly meat-eaters, their digestive systems are simply not built to process heavy loads of complex carbohydrates.

Eating these pastries can easily lead to severe bloating, stomach cramps, and general digestive distress. Regularly feeding your cat sugary and starchy human treats will also cause weight gain and long-term blood sugar problems. Additionally, these pastries often contain hidden hazards like chocolate, excessive salt, or even toxic onion and garlic powder in savory versions.

Sticky products like mochi and rice cakes carry an extra physical risk. Because of their dense and chewy texture, they present a severe choking hazard. A cat could easily get a sticky piece lodged in their throat or intestines. While a tiny accidental bite is not an emergency, you should avoid giving these pastries to your cat entirely.
